latest_evidence.result: Unique-per-attempt and content-hash-fork retry identities are falsified for orphan boundedness. A deterministic candidate path keyed by the frozen parent LATEST blob plus fixed parent+1 logical revision, combined with canonical deterministic payload bytes, create-if-absent, exact-match retry, mismatch diagnostic, and pointer-last CAS, bounds repeated failed/stale retries from one parent to at most one distinct candidate path without overwriting or auto-adopting mismatched content in the tested model.

candidate_revision: Use deterministic parent+next-revision candidate identity as the preferred orphan-creation control in the tested checkpoint/pointer model, together with r173 reachability-plus-two-confirmed-generation cleanup after pointer progress resumes. Canonical payload determinism is mandatory; a deterministic path with volatile bytes is only storage-bounded but can be liveness-blocking.
tested_scope: Deterministic role-local one-pointer CAS model with immutable candidates, next revision fixed to parent+1, canonical bytes, create-if-absent/exact-match collision handling; tested repeated pre-CAS interruption, matching/mismatching same-parent concurrency, stale writer after valid advance, and overwrite guard. No live production collision was induced and no claim is made for noncanonical payloads, multi-pointer authority, or silent-overwrite transports.

phase1_constraints.quota_note: Scheduled-Chat reasoning plus lightweight repository state transport only; no hosted runner, finite optional quota, protected authority, manual user execution, or incremental monetary cost is required.

conflict_check: Only frozen sanitized controls, own LATEST/r173 state and one public GitHub contents-API source were used. No O/O-derived, other-worker, downstream, legacy, aggregate-ledger, other-role receipt/config, scheduler or protected-primary semantic input was read or mutated.
frontier: Test interruption and rate-limit recovery for the deterministic parent/revision candidate without same-run retry: candidate create succeeds but pointer update is unavailable; next invocation reconstructs the same K/bytes and attempts only the pointer transition subject to current authority.
Then test separation of canonical immutable semantic candidate bytes from non-authoritative per-invocation receipt metadata without reintroducing duplicate candidate identities.
exact_continuation: Next invocation, after manifest/RUN_LIFECYCLE-first bootstrap and exact authority freeze, read LATEST and r174 only as needed, then execute exactly one bounded interruption/rate-limit recovery model leaf. Simulate candidate-create success followed by pointer-write unavailability and normal return with no same-run retry; on the next invocation require reconstruction of the same K and exact bytes, then allow only (a) pointer CAS if the frozen parent is still current, (b) exact-match no-op if the pointer already targets that candidate, or (c) stale/authority-mismatch diagnostic if LATEST changed. Falsify if recovery writes a second candidate path, silently replaces mismatched bytes, or adopts a stale candidate after parent change.
